drawing_choices.lighting: key, fill and rim rig of rig.py, nucleus rim light, shadow catcher, ambient occlusion and depth haze (rig.py docstring)
drawing_choices.mesh: spheres 24 x 12, sticks 12 segments (memory rule R10)
drawing_choices.style: ball-and-stick for every species, atom radius 0.28 x van der Waals (ase.data), sticks 0.14 A (template 0.19 A)
drawing_choices.water_shell: water drawn only behind the plane through the lens axis and within 7 A of the slab, template, ions and nucleus; opacity 0.2 to 2.5 A, falling linearly to 0 at 7 A

drawing_choices.acc_min_distances: Ca-Ca 3.4, Ca-C 2.9, Ca-O 2.3, C-C 3.0, O-O 2.5 A exclusion distances of the insertion (drawing rule)
drawing_choices.acc_structural_water: the structural water of ACC (0.5-1.1 H2O per CaCO3 in the sourced rows) is not drawn
drawing_choices.base_height: 11 A, the lens base resting on the catechol layer (chain tops at 12-13 A)
drawing_choices.base_radius: 15 A lens base radius, chosen so the lens reads as a cap rather than a cluster
drawing_choices.chain: generic 4-unit 5,6-dihydroxyindole chain, MMFF94 conformer, rigid body (structure of the layer is debated)
drawing_choices.contact_angle_deg: 50 degrees, an illustration of the partial wetting that W3's analysis allows (not a result)
drawing_choices.placements: chain sites and azimuths, dissolved carbonate positions and the lens centre are composition choices
drawing_choices.slab: bulk corundum spacings, unrelaxed; OH 0.97 A tilted 15 degrees
drawing_choices.water: random sequential insertion at 1 g/cm3, rigid gas-phase geometry, not equilibrated
